Equalizer: Audio frequency-response processor, not social equality.
Post gain: Signal level adjustment after EQ processing, in dB; permits attenuation as well as amplification. Not financial profit.
Gain: Audio signal level adjustment in dB, positive or negative. Not financial profit.
Bands: Frequency bands in an audio equalizer. Not music groups, belts or radio stations.
Selected band: Currently selected frequency band in the equalizer.
Flat: Preset with zero equalizer gain at every frequency. Not an apartment; does not imply muted audio.
Reset to flat: Restore zero gain in all EQ bands. Does not mute playback.
Balance: Left/right audio channel balance. Not bank balance or physical equilibrium.
Quit app: Exit the process and unload audio processing; closing the window alone keeps the app running.
Natural mic EQ: Microphone equalization feature intended to produce natural-sounding audio. Not a claim that the microphone has a measured neutral response.
Use system locale: Use the operating system regional number/date formatting settings; independent of interface language.
Listening preset: Saved equalizer settings for playback. Not a listening device.
Lock EQ: Prevent accidental editing of EQ controls; not encryption or a security lock.
Undo: Reverse the previous editable setting change.
Filter Q: Dimensionless filter quality factor, not bandwidth in Hz. Processing parameter and stable identifier remain q.
Source position: Protected stretch marker offset in physical source-sample frames from the retained nominal raw origin; not an absolute project frame or a filename. Integer acoustic positions use ungrouped digits.
Target position: Protected stretch marker offset in physical frames in the prepared derivative, independent of project sample rate or linked playback speed.
Marker: A stable user stretch anchor. Its displayed UUID prefix is not translated. This is not a project navigation marker.
Prepare audition: Prepare an ephemeral playback model for the verified derivative without modifying the project or playing automatically. Output channels are chosen before Play audition.
Play audition: Play the verified pending derivative on the explicitly chosen outputs before committing Apply. Audition output choices do not change saved project routes.
Stop audition: Retire the temporary playback endpoint; keep the pending verified result available for Apply. This does not cancel a render or undo an edit.
Experimental protected stretch markers: Explicit transient-protected offline editing mode. Broader acoustic and sustained multichannel phase quality remain unqualified; preserve the experimental scope.
Verified protected marker plan: %n marke: Count of original user marker owners in the verified derivative plan. Numerus entry; retain %n and provide the language plural forms when reviewed.
